description: A photograph depicting a managed green urban area. In the foreground, a vibrant green, gently sloped lawn is visible, bordered by a paved pathway on the left. The lawn features a few small, young trees or shrubs. The middle ground includes a road with several parked cars (white, grey, and red) and a line of larger trees and bushes. In the background, a prominent multi-story residential building with light yellow facades and multiple balconies dominates the scene, representing urban fabric. Other buildings are partially visible further left. The sky appears partly cloudy. This image illustrates a "green urban area" within a developed environment, a common category in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) products like Urban Atlas or CORINE Land Cover (CLC+), typically distinct from dense 'Urban fabric' or 'Industrial, commercial and military units'.
